fichas.title: Bathrooms: planning and warm-water requirements
fichas.summary: A bathroom is an independent room with a bath or shower and toilet, and is part of the minimum equipment of a flat or house. In larger houses, bath and WC should be in separate rooms, or an additional guest WC should be provided. The text recommends a north orientation and natural lighting and ventilation where possible; otherwise provide effective mechanical ventilation according to DIN 18017-3. Bathrooms are normally near bedrooms. For technical reasons, bath and kitchen, or WC and kitchen, may share an installation shaft. The table gives guideline warm-water quantities, temperatures, and approximate durations for bathing and showering.
